title: Killing the two Thornwold toll-men — petty extortionists Captain Vane herself dismissed as 'Company rules, not mine' — permanently marked Free Companies reputation with no warning, silently foreclosing 'The Smugglers' Road' and Vane's oath-quest for the rest of the run.
